title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-9n2n: protect_response_with_reserved_piv missing mark_response_used
description: The protect_response method (line 931) now correctly calls mark_response_used after generating a new response PIV. However, protect_response_with_reserved_piv (line 1026) also generates a response PIV but does NOT call mark_response_used. This means the response_window is not updated when using the durable reservation path (ReservedSender::protect_response_with_piv at line 1374). This is the same class of bug that this commit fixes for the non-persisted path. The mark_response_used call should be added to protect_response_with_reserved_piv to keep the response window accurate.
